**The [[United States]] announces that [[North Korea]] will destroy the [[Sohae Satellite Launching Station]] missile test site. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/us-identifies-north-korea-missile-test-site-to-be-destroyed (''The Straits Times'')]
;Law and crime
*[[Sara Netanyahu]], wife of [[Prime Minister of Israel|Israel's Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]], is charged with fraud over the alleged misuse of state funds at their residence. [https://www.cnn.com/2018/06/21/middleeast/sara-netanyahu-indicted-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*The [[United States Supreme Court]] allows states to collect sales taxes from online retailers that do not have a "physical presence" in that state. [https://www.politico.com/story/2018/06/21/supreme-court-online-sales-tax-collection-661647 (''Politico'')]
*[[Murder of Altantuya Shaariibuu]], [[Malaysia-Mongolia relations]]
**[[Malaysia]]n authorities announce the reopening of investigations into the murder of a [[Mongolia]]n model by two police officers associated with former Prime Minister [[Najib Razak]]. Who ordered the killing has never been determined. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-malaysia-politics-mongolia/malaysia-reopens-probe-into-mongolian-model-murdered-by-najibs-former-bodyguards-idUSKBN1JH0YW (Reuters)]
;Politics and elections
*[[Trump administration family separation policy]], [[Protests against Trump administration family separation policy]]
**[[U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement]] temporarily closes their [[Portland, Oregon|Portland]], [[Oregon]], offices after protesters camping outside the building grow in numbers. [https://www.cnn.com/2018/06/21/us/ice-portland-office-shut-down/index.html (CNN)]
**First Lady [[Melania Trump]] makes a surprise visit to the US-Mexico border to get a firsthand look at the immigration crisis. [http://cnycentral.com/news/nation-world/first-lady-melania-trump-visits-us-mexico-border-amid-crisis-over-migrant-children (WSTM-TV)]
*[[New Zealand]] [[Prime Minister of New Zealand|Prime Minister]] [[Jacinda Ardern]] gives birth to a baby girl at 4:45 p.m. [[NZST|local time]] (04:45 UTC). Ardern is the first incumbent head of government to give birth since [[Pakistani Prime Minister]] [[Benazir Bhutto]] in 1990. [https://www.newshub.co.nz/home/new-zealand/2018/06/it-s-a-girl-jacinda-ardern-gives-birth-to-her-first-child.html (Newshub)] [https://www.cnn.com/2018/06/20/world/new-zealand-prime-minister-jacinda-ardern-baby/index.html (CNN)]
